title: 45 Deploys, Not 3 Days
caption:
I shipped an app in a weekend and then didn't open it again for four months.

Bubble just put a number on why that died. They measured 250,000 apps across their first six months. The ones making money deployed about 45 times. The ones that weren't deployed twice. Not a better idea — 43 more deploys.

Worth saying it's Bubble's own data about Bubble apps, and Bubble would love you to keep editing on Bubble. The 20x gap is still the most honest thing I've read about shipping this year.

How many deploys since launch?
